title: 1.4 The Mission of Physics and Career Awareness
description: The mission of physics and career opportunities in physics-related fields

questions.question: What is the mission of physics?
options: To advance science, engineering, and innovation throughout the world for the benefit of all, and in doing so serve society
To build machines and devices for private companies only
To generate electricity for homes and industries
To study only the stars and planets in space
questions.correctAnswer: To advance science, engineering, and innovation throughout the world for the benefit of all, and in doing so serve society

questions.question: In serving society, physics aims to benefit all of humanity around the world. How does the mission of physics describe this goal?
options: Advancing science, engineering, and innovation for the benefit of all
questions.correctAnswer: Advancing science, engineering, and innovation for the benefit of all

questions.question: A physicist works to develop new inventions and improve technology for the benefit of everyone in the world. Which statement best matches the mission of physics?
options: To serve society by advancing science, engineering, and innovation
To focus only on understanding the universe
To increase the profits of technology companies
To replace all other fields of science
questions.correctAnswer: To serve society by advancing science, engineering, and innovation
